items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: Nat Hentoff, who wrote more than one set of liner notes for your father over the years

ctx.x: I love it. And Nat Hentoff, who wrote more than one set of liner notes for your father over the years, he was talking about “Sound Pieces” and he said, “There are no arcane © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
implications to this music,” followed by your father saying, “It could be for trombone and snare drum.” So my question is, and it’s sort of a broad question—
